triples.subject: Alexey Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Ever since Lise took back her promise—her childish promise, Alexey Fyodorovitch—to marry you, you’ve realized, of course, that it was only the playful fancy of a sick child

triples.subject: Rakitin
triples.quote: that frivolous young man, would you believe it, seems to have taken it into his head to fall in love with me.

triples.subject: Father Zossima
triples.quote: stated that he and his elder, Father Zossima, had broken into the monastery chest and “made tracks from the monastery.”

triples.subject: Rakitin
triples.quote: He had met Pyotr Ilyitch here before, and would you believe it, he is always gibing at him, growling at him, for some reason.

triples.subject: Madame Hohlakov
triples.quote: You know I turned him out of the house.... You know all that story, don’t you?

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: I can’t trust my daughter so easily to your brother Ivan Fyodorovitch, though I still consider him the most chivalrous young man.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: It’s very important for me to be in time to see my brother to-day,” Alyosha faltered.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: knowing what a lot he has to do as it is, _vous comprenez, cette affaire et la mort terrible de votre papa_.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: Oh! not better that a son should have killed his father, I don’t defend that.

triples.subject: Yulia
triples.quote: early this morning Lise waked up and flew into a passion with Yulia and, would you believe it, slapped her in the face. That’s monstrous; I am always polite to my servants.

triples.subject: Rakitin
triples.quote: Then, instead of laughing, your friend flew into a rage. ‘Good gracious!’ I thought, ‘they’ll fly at each other.’

triples.subject: Madame Hohlakov
triples.quote: I got up suddenly and said to Rakitin, ‘It’s painful for me to say it, but I don’t wish to see you in my house again.’ So I turned him out.

triples.subject: Lise
triples.quote: early this morning Lise waked up and flew into a passion with Yulia and, would you believe it, slapped her in the face.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: He came in shouting, ‘Money, money, three thousand! Give me three thousand!’ and then went away and immediately did the murder.

triples.subject: Grigory
triples.quote: Yes, I know it was that old man Grigory murdered him.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: He lay as Dmitri Fyodorovitch struck him down, and then got up, saw the door open, went in and killed Fyodor Pavlovitch.

triples.subject: Madame Hohlakov
triples.quote: I can never remember poetry. I’ve got it here. I’ll show it to you later.

triples.subject: Madame Hohlakov
triples.quote: come back and tell me—me, her mother, for you understand it will be the death of me

triples.subject: Yulia
triples.quote: That’s monstrous; I am always polite to my servants. And an hour later she was hugging Yulia’s feet

triples.subject: Lise
triples.quote: slapped her in the face. That’s monstrous; I am always polite to my servants. And an hour later she was hugging Yulia’s feet
